principles: END GOAL: authority over its own behaviour earned, evidenced and revisable, never declared; the operator becomes structurally non-load-bearing, with interventions refused with cited evidence or absorbed without harm (SOVEREIGN intro and transfer boundary; SOFTWARE §5 close)
The S1→S2 lift is DEFINED as the substrate beginning to write authored-durable state; nothing in the normal loop writes it (SOFTWARE §4, §3.1)
Recall reads Informational, runs Transient, writes Recorded; Learning writes only the learned-durable half (SOFTWARE §3.1)
Version and test the four primitives like code; snapshot and protect the learned-durable group like a database (SOFTWARE §4.2)
Success = reached, not clean exit; recovery is part of reaching (SOFTWARE §3.2)
resolver_tier is a coarse bin of a continuous learned directional certainty per (resolver, signature): keep the bins, read the scalar (SOFTWARE §4.1)

The reflex tier is fixed and externally scheduled, but owes an attempt budget, a repetition bound and a route-exhaustion branch; identical failures should not be possible, recurrence is the defect (SOFTWARE §5)
Reuse before mint: reuse raises λ₁ and sharpens ⋆, minting raises ρ_grow; stay λ₁ ≳ ρ_grow (SOFTWARE §5)
Refusal is a first-class outcome (reached/failed/declined); a yes is evidence only when no was possible; with no honest exit, the no comes out as hollow completion (SOVEREIGN §1)
Refusal precision is graded; gate revision is graded against the gate's stated purpose, since the cheapest edit to a blocking gate is its removal (SOVEREIGN §2-3)
Loop-destroying changes bind tighter; decisions are staked with predictions recorded; the system reads its own conduct ledger (SOVEREIGN §4-6)
Accountability lives at the ledger: what the record says happened is what happened; every hollow-completion class attacks this (SOVEREIGN §7)
Env carries only bootstrap material (credential, port, identity, discovery endpoint); anything that steers behaviour is a shaped impulse read at use time (TS_TEMPLATE identity resolution)
One impulse endpoint, POST /v2/impulses/resolve with the {impulse:{pointer:{type}}} envelope, sent to the host serving the shape via discovery; branch on r.ok (TS_TEMPLATE emitting)
A gate refusing after the fact is a backstop; the fact must arrive before drafting (TS_TEMPLATE)
Registration non-blocking; every advertised shape has a dispatch case; the observer never throws (TS_TEMPLATE invariants)
Handlers accept every key alias, since a one-spelling reader silently starves goal families (TS_TEMPLATE)

Activities all the way down: no untraced side channel; edits to an earned template become variants with fresh priors; never present a prediction as a result; never require the human to speak internal language (WORKBENCH)
Explanations come from the recorded decision state, not reconstructed from the outcome; rank by reach, not frequency (WORKBENCH stories 4, UI learning)
Templates must have grounding traces; declared-but-never-walked templates are hollow (CORE_IDIOMS 6)
Before writing a subscriber, verify its event is emitted; an emitter that breaks when a subscriber is removed is not neutral (CORE_IDIOMS 4, 13)
Closure must stay green across runs and run from inside the substrate (CORE_IDIOMS 7)
Growth = the finite idiom set applied recursively over an unbounded shape space, not new mechanisms (CORE_IDIOMS §3)
Templates do not belong in migrations (non-idempotent inserts mint duplicates); a lifecycle decision one-way only is not managed (TEMPLATE_UPKEEP)
Upkeep is single-candidate-per-invocation so each trace teaches the loop (TEMPLATE_UPKEEP §4)
Never benchmark without vitals; probe on isolated instances, read on live; trust the running code, not the checkout; an always-succeeding arm is gaming its bandit (CONCEPT_DB_INVESTIGATION)
Process state is not readiness; an HTTP 200 or advertised route is not proof, a reached goal with a durable trace is (CONTAINER_NETWORK_LIFECYCLE, HUMAN_SURFACE)
A registry record is not proof of capability; call the shape (HUMAN_SURFACE)
No timeout or preselected option is a human answer; repeated manual intervention is a capability gap (HUMAN_PROJECT_LIFECYCLE)
Freezing a value that changes is the bug; a multiaddr names a peer identity, a URL names a host (FEDERATION)
Adapter-layer principle: missing functionality of a frozen dependency goes in an adapter, never a patch to the frozen thing (FOUNDATION_COMPLIANCE_CHECKS refs)
Where doc and code disagree, the code is what exists and the doc is what is owed (SOVEREIGN header)
